title: SWF: anchor-type frame labels missing from tag 86 SceneAndFrameLabelData
description: labelType==='anchor' is excluded from SceneAndFrameLabelData (tag 86). Anchor frames must appear in BOTH tag 86 AND as FrameLabel tag 43 with named-anchor flag 0x01. Currently tag 86 silently omits them so gotoAndPlay("anchorName") fails to resolve across scenes even though per-frame tag 43 is emitted correctly in sprite.ts line 317. Fix: include labelType==='anchor' in the tag-86 frame label list in packages/swf/src/scenelabels.ts.
